news.headline: RECORD FLOOD CONTINUES — NWS Melbourne: Flash Flood Warnings for central Brevard into Thu afternoon (to 1:45 PM), Flood Watch for Orange, Osceola, Seminole, Volusia, Brevard & most of east-central Florida through Fri Nov 20 7 PM; St. Johns River near Cocoa at 18.0 ft at 5:15 AM Thu, above the flood of record (flood stage 16 ft), forecast to stay above record levels through late week/weekend — 3–6 in. of rain forecast, isolated 8–12 in.

U.S. housing starts rose 9.9% in October to 1.309 million annual rate — single-family starts up 4.0% to 864,000 — but building permits fell 7.4% to 1.295 million, with single-family permits down 8.7% to 772,000, lowest since January 2023

Builder confidence fell 4 points to 25 in November, lowest since April 2012 — 46% of builders cut prices and buyer traffic fell to 16; Florida closed home sales fell 9.4% from a year earlier in October, and U.S. pending home sales fell 4.7% in October (South down 6.3%)

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31 — permit application date governs which edition applies; Miami-Dade portal cutoff is 4 PM Dec 30, with new flood documentation and coastal corrosion rules

Copper at seven-month low Thu midday — Comex copper $5.65/lb at 11:26 AM ET Nov 19, LME copper lowest since April amid strong dollar and AI-demand doubts; North American clean copper scrap fell 31¢/lb in the Nov 18 session, down 60¢/lb since Nov 11

Regency Electric acquires Tekline Electrical Services of Chandler, AZ — expanding the Colorado commercial electrical contractor into Arizona; Tekline serves manufacturing, healthcare, education, hospitality and industrial markets

Fed minutes released Wed Nov 18 read hawkish — almost all October FOMC participants judged further rate hikes likely in months ahead to return inflation to 2%; funds held at 3.75–4.00% by 10–2 vote, next meeting Dec 8–9, markets pricing ~95% odds of a December hike, S&P 500 fell 0.23% Wed to 7,323.63 for a fifth straight loss
Florida workers' comp: Commissioner Yaworsky approved NCCI's −7.4% average rate cut for new and renewal policies from Jan 1, 2027 — 11th straight year of reductions

NBA Wed: Heat 137, Bucks 130 — Giannis Antetokounmpo 27 pts, 13 reb, 9 ast in his first game vs. his former team, Miami's 6th straight win; 76ers 121, Magic 116 — Franz Wagner 27 pts & 11 ast for Orlando; Magic next at Brooklyn Fri Nov 20, Heat host Oklahoma City Sun Nov 22

NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22 — all Florida teams on the road: Buccaneers (3-6) at Lions (7-2) 1 PM ET, Dolphins (1-8) at Bills (8-1) 1 PM ET, Jaguars (7-2) at Giants 4:25 PM ET; Bucs QB Baker Mayfield missed practice Wed with a foot injury — decision expected Fri, rookie Jalon Daniels would start if he cannot go
